Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social

Record Class SocialProperties

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social.SocialProperties
Record Components:
providers - settings of each provider, by registration id (google, microsoft, apple, github).
@ConfigurationProperties("authserver.social") public record SocialProperties(Map<String,SocialProperties.Provider> providers) extends Record
Settings of the sign-in with external providers, bound once from authserver.social.* and injected wherever one is needed; an invalid value stops the application at startup. A provider is enabled when its client-id has text: a blank one leaves the provider off, so the shipped application.yml can list all of them with the values of environment variables and nothing is enabled until a deployment supplies them. Secrets (the client secret, the Apple private key) are never kept in a committed file: they come from the environment only.

Whether a provider's own multi-factor authentication is trusted (trust-mfa) is per provider and off by default: the sign-in is then a primary factor and the normal second-factor flow applies.
